name: CCA 101 撞未知物体 风挡裂

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CCA 101 and you are at Wuhan Airport, you are now taxiing on taxiway A3 to taxiway A.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 CCA 101，位于 Wuhan Airport，现在正在从滑行道 A3 滑向滑行道 A。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA 101, taxiing from taxiway A3 to A.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CCA 101，正从滑行道 A3 滑向 A。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 101, taxi with extreme caution and keep close to the centerline of your taxiway.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 101，极其谨慎滑行，并靠近你所在滑行道中心线。
cards.referenceText: Keep close to the centerline of the taxiway, CCA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 靠近滑行道中心线，CCA 101。

cards.audioText: B: You want to check with Wuhan Ground for NOTAM bulletin A0011.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你想向武汉地面确认 NOTAM 通告 A0011。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA 101, confirm NOTAM A0011.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CCA 101，确认 NOTAM A0011。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 101, latest bulletin A0011 says taxiway A3 is newly repaired on the second mid section of the left side.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 101，最新通告 A0011 说滑行道 A3 左侧第二中段新近修复。
cards.referenceText: Roger, taxiway A3 is newly repaired on the second mid section of the left side, CCA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，滑行道 A3 左侧第二中段新近修复，CCA 101。

cards.audioText: B: You are approaching the holding point of Runway 36R, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你正接近跑道 36R 等待点，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA 101, approaching the holding point of Runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA 101，接近跑道 36R 等待点。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 101, hold short, traffic on final.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 101，等待，五边有交通。
cards.referenceText: Hold short, CCA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 等待，CCA 101。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 101, we've just been informed a large bird was sacked into your port engine a moment, please check.
B: Say your EGT of port engine is not in normal range, you figure something is wrong and you ask the controller for his instruction.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 101，我们刚被告知一只大鸟刚才被吸入你的左发，请检查。
B: 说你的左发 EGT 不在正常范围，你判断有问题，并向管制员请求指令。
cards.referenceText: Roger, our EGT of port engine is not in normal range, CCA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，我们左发 EGT 不在正常范围，CCA 101。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 101, hold at your present position.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 101，在当前位置等待。
cards.referenceText: Hold at present position, CCA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在当前位置等待，CCA 101。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 101, the maintenance department asked you to shut down the right engine straight away.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 101，维修部门要求你立即关停右发。
cards.referenceText: We will shut down the engine, CCA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们将关停发动机，CCA 101。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 101, we send you a tug to tow you back to the maintenance bay.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 101，我们派拖车把你拖回维修机位。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, CCA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，CCA 101。

cards.audioText:
B: After settling the problem, you took off, now you are under Departure control.
C: CCA 101, cancel SID, track direct to GH, climb and maintain 1800 meters.
cards.audioTextZh:
B: 解决问题后，你起飞了，现在由 Departure 管制。
C: CCA 101，取消 SID，直飞 GH，爬升并保持 1800 米。
cards.referenceText: Cancel SID, track direct to GH, climb and maintain 1800 meters, CCA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 取消 SID，直飞 GH，爬升并保持 1800 米，CCA 101。

cards.audioText: B: You are now over GH, report to ATC that you have observed a balloon at your eleven o'clock position 3 miles away.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你现在在 GH 上空，向 ATC 报告在 11 点钟方向 3 海里处看到一个气球。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, CCA 101, over GH, we observed a balloon at our 11 o'clock position 3 miles away.
cards.referenceTextZh: Wuhan Departure，CCA 101，过 GH，我们在 11 点钟方向 3 海里处看到一个气球。

cards.audioText:
C: Roger, 101, climb to and maintain 3900 meters on standard, i'll check the balloon.
B: Report to ATC you collided with an unknown foreign object, the windshield is broken.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 收到，101，按标准气压爬升并保持 3900 米，我会查明该气球。
B: 向 ATC 报告你撞上了不明外来物，风挡破裂。
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 3900 meters on standard, we collided with an unknown foreign object, the windshield is broken, CCA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按标准气压爬升并保持 3900 米，我们撞上不明外来物，风挡破裂，CCA 101。

cards.audioText:
C: Roger, 101, say your intention.
B: Tell ATC that you decide to go back to the departing airport.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 收到，101，说明你的意图。
B: 告诉 ATC 你决定返回起飞机场。
cards.referenceText: Request go back to the departing airport, CCA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求返回起飞机场，CCA 101。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 101, turn left heading 280.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 101，左转航向 280。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 280, CCA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 280，CCA 101。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 101, turn left heading 240.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 101，左转航向 240。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 240, CCA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 240，CCA 101。

cards.audioText: B: Your TCAS is activated, and your aircraft is descending under TCAS control, report to ATC.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的 TCAS 启动，飞机正在 TCAS 控制下下降，向 ATC 报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, CCA 101, TCAS descending.
cards.referenceTextZh: Wuhan Departure，CCA 101，TCAS 下降。

cards.audioText:
C: Roger, what is the problem?
B: Tell the controller you have a conflicting traffic, it's Boeing 757, at about 2 o'clock from right to left.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 收到，是什么问题？
B: 告诉管制员你有冲突交通，是 Boeing 757，约在 2 点钟方向从右向左。
cards.referenceText: We have a conflicting traffic, it's B757, at about 2 o'clock from right to left, CCA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们有冲突交通，是 B757，约在 2 点钟方向从右向左，CCA 101。

cards.audioText: C: Roger, 101, turn left heading 210, descend to 1200 meters on QNH 1002.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 收到，101，左转航向 210，按 QNH 1002 下降到 1200 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 210, descend to 1200 meters on QNH 1002, CCA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 210，按 QNH 1002 下降到 1200 米，CCA 101。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 101, turn left heading 070, this will lead you ILS approach Runway 36R, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 101，左转航向 070，这将引导你进行跑道 36R ILS 进近，建立后报告。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 070, ILS approach Runway 36R, report established, CCA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 070，跑道 36R ILS 进近，建立后报告，CCA 101。
